## Cloud answer (cloud#3334 item 6): the bundles were there; cloud's locale wrapper was the cause — fixed in objectstack-ai/cloud#3339

**Premise:** `d284ff3f8c` (PR #26072) is an ancestor of cloud's pin `6390fe52`.

**Measured at the pin** (the real control plane booted from `apps/cloud/server`): the i18n service is a `FileI18nAdapter` with locales `en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES`, and `getTranslations('zh-CN').objects.sys_member.fields.role.options.member` is 「成员」; `translateMetaList` over `sys_member.role` answers 成员 for `zh-CN` (and `zh`). So neither suspected composition fault holds.

**Actual cause:** cloud wraps the plane's `email` service (`withWorkspaceInvitationLocale`, cloud#2649) to move an `auth.invitation` send to the workspace's language when the invitee names none. plugin-auth renders `{{role}}` first, in the locale IT chose: for a new address, the deployment default (`invitationRoleLabel(role, undefined)` → `en-US` → "Member"). The wrapper then changed only `locale`, so the zh-CN body said "Member". The #26072 warning would never fire for this, since the label was asked for in English.

**Fix (objectstack-ai/cloud#3339):** when the wrapper moves the locale it names the role again in that locale ([`packages/service-cloud/src/workspace-invitation-locale.ts:237`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/service-cloud/src/workspace-invitation-locale.ts#L237), used at [`:306`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/service-cloud/src/workspace-invitation-locale.ts#L306)): the role from the `sys_invitation` row the send names, the label through `@objectstack/spec/system`'s `translateMetadataDocument` over the plane's i18n bundles (the translator `translateMetaList` uses). A role with no label keeps the framework's; a failed read never blocks the send.
- Test: the real better-auth invite on the booted control plane ([`apps/cloud/test/signup-org-flow.test.ts:771`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/apps/cloud/test/signup-org-flow.test.ts#L771)) — the zh-CN body reads 「…邀请您以 成员 的身份加入…」 with no "Member"; red before the fix. Unit cases in `packages/service-cloud/test/workspace-invitation-locale.test.ts`.

**Upstream note (not a request):** the root shape is that `sendInvitationEmail` renders a locale-dependent value before a host can move the locale. A host locale resolver for the invitation send (like plugin-audit's `getLocale`) would let cloud drop the re-render. Hosted read after deploy: a zh-CN workspace invitation names 成员.

Verified fixed end to end, 2026-10-29T05:46Z: local stack on cloud `main` `90e673e8` (cloud#3362, framework pin `eef83734`; carries cloud#3339). The owner invited a member from the cloud home's 「邀请成员」 in a zh-CN session. The invitation mail stored by the control plane (`sys_email`) reads:

> 何雨（he.mf1029@example.com）邀请您以 **成员** 的身份加入 ObjectOS Cloud 上的 雨空间家居。
> …
> 此邀请将于 2026年10月31日 GMT+8 13:45:52 过期。

The role is the Chinese label (was 「Member」 on pin `6390fe52` / cloud `3cc587ca`, 2026-10-27), and the expiry line from the 2026-10-25 comment is present. Nothing left to observe on this path from the E2E side; closing is the owning seat's call.
